subject: StratusGrid: Marketplace vendor PO intake + evidence & remit details
messages:
From: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@stratusgrid.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stratusgrid.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO intake for Redwood listing

Hi Vanessa (and team),

Thanks for taking this — StratusGrid is preparing to list on AWS, Azure and GCP marketplaces and we need to get vendor setup + PO routing completed so billing can flow to marketplace charges. High level asks from procurement: 

- Confirm vendor legal name, W-9 (US) and VAT (EU) handling
- PO remit / invoicing address and preferred invoice format (pdf/email vs. marketplace bill-to)
- SOC 2 summary / security confirmation for marketplace listing
- Bank wiring details (for any direct invoice exceptions)
- Typical lead time to activate listing in each cloud marketplace (approx)

I attached a draft PO (draft_po_stratusgrid_0428.pdf) and our procurement intake worksheet. Target: have paperwork in routing by end of next week (Apr 18). Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the intake and provide the intake template back filled?

Thanks — I can loop Procurement if helpful.

--
Emma Hayes
Procurement Manager, StratusGrid Inc.
emma.hayes@stratusgrid.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: draft_po_stratusgrid_0428.pdf, procurement_intake_template.xlsx
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@stratusgrid.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO intake for Redwood listing

Emma — really appreciate the clear list. We'll take point on this and aim to return a consolidated packet. Quick notes and next steps: 

1) Ownership: Ben Carter (FinOps / Marketplace onboarding) will be the primary contact for PO + tax forms. Lauren Bishop (Legal Ops) will handle any purchase order T&Cs and invoice remit exceptions.
2) Intake artifacts we need from you to speed routing: legal entity name exactly as appears on W-9, a signed W-9 (or W-8BEN if non-us), SOC 2 summary (pdf), and the draft PO you attached.
3) Marketplace specifics: For GCP we commonly ask for a billing contact + project ID if you want direct marketplace billing; AWS and Azure typically flow via their marketplace billing unless you request a direct invoice. We'll confirm final path once we have the W-9 and remit info.
4) Timeline: If you send the filled intake within 48 hours we can start routing to finance and legal the same day; target activation on our side in ~10 business days assuming no redlines.

I've attached our vendor intake form (vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf). Ben — can you pick this up and run the PO through payment ops? Lauren — FYI in case any legal review is needed for the PO wording.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Director, Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding / PO intake for Redwood listing

Emma — thanks for the speedy turnaround and the attachments. I reviewed the PO and supporting docs; a few items and proposed actions below: 

- Remit address: The address you've listed (210 Harbor Way, SF) is fine for our GL mapping. Please make sure the invoice includes your Tax ID and W-9 reference.
- Invoice routing: For marketplace charges we prefer marketplace bill-to where possible (keeps reconciliation simpler). If you need direct invoicing for any one-off services, send PDFs to billing@redwood.com and mark the PO number on the invoice header.
- GCP billing contact: Please include a technical contact so we can create the listing ticket. Proposed contact: Diego Fernandez (diego.fernandez@redwood.com) — he will own the marketplace listing creation and can be cc'd on the billing ticket.
- Terms/Payment: Our standard is Net30 unless an alternate term was negotiated in the PO. If StratusGrid needs Net45/Net60 let us know and we can escalate.

I've attached the completed vendor intake form (vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf) and a clean copy of the PO with our GL codes added (vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf, draft_po_stratusgrid_0428.pdf). Next steps:

1) Emma — confirm remit address and whether you want marketplace bill-to or direct invoices for the initial quarter.
2) Once confirmed we'll issue a finance ticket to enable vendor in our marketplace onboarding queue.
3) Lauren — please advise if you see any unusual redlines on the PO T&Cs.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
FinOps, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
